conditions: An entity with aggregate annual revenue of at least USD 10,000,000 must obtain a paid commercial agreement before commercial use.

An entity below that threshold may proceed only after an authorized reviewer accepts the community license, use restrictions, and applicable AI-law, transparency, provenance, safety, and distribution duties.
Commercial entities may use the free evaluation exception only when no direct or indirect payment arises and the work stays non-production and non-end-user-facing.
Any distribution or hosted access must carry the agreement, notices, restrictions, and downstream obligations required by the license.
Preserve and do not bypass any safety, disclosure, watermarking, provenance, or transparency feature included in the model or output path.
